provenance.license: No reuse license found in inspected source landing page; retain attribution and review reuse terms
provenance.notes: Original manifold/sphere geometry, arrows and source math glyph outlines preserved. Nine ant-state thumbnails remain independent transparent raster images; no whole-figure raster is embedded.
provenance.extraction_review: pending; native geometry extraction is not visual fidelity approval
provenance.font_substitutions: CMU Serif and Nimbus Roman ordinary labels use Times New Roman or the editor Times-compatible fallback. Original geometry and math outlines retained.
provenance.outlined_math_limit: Selected source mathematical fonts preserved as editable glyph outlines, not live equation/text objects.
provenance.dash_fidelity: PPTX uses the closest supported native preset, not exact PDF dash lengths. Draw.io retains interval lengths; PDF phase/caps are not preserved; zero intervals become 0.001 scene units.
extraction_warnings: 4 source clipping groups intersect crop; extracted paths require explicit clipping review
provenance.reviewed_arrow_repair: Straight thumbnail arrows use explicit union outlines; curved thumbnail arrow uses separate source subpaths, avoiding editor even-odd cancellation at the shaft/head join.
provenance.text_editability: Ordinary diagram labels and panel/callout prose are native typeable text. Mathematical glyph outlines, where present, remain editable point paths, not live equations.
